question: Where did my note go?
instrument: Select a saved note, preview the request, and keep the resulting trace.
mechanisms: Request/response boundaries; context assembly; roles; truncation; tool access; retrieval; application state versus parameters.

question: Why did that tiny edit change the cost?
instrument: Bring two texts whose small difference matters to your notebook. A tokenizer probe is the next instrument to build.
mechanisms: Bytes, tokenisation, vocabulary, context length, embeddings, matrix dimensions.

question: How far can a machine get by counting?
instrument: Build a tiny transition generator around a chosen harmless corpus; keep its useful failure cases.
mechanisms: Conditional probability, distributions, logits, softmax, entropy, cross-entropy, sampling; limited state.

question: The clue is present. Can it affect this answer?
instrument: Trace a small numerical computation and change one dependency.
mechanisms: Position, causal masks, Q/K/V attention, residual paths, normalisation, feed-forward blocks and forward pass. Attention weights alone do not explain a real model.

references.title: Attention Is All You Need (original paper)

question: Which numbers changed, and why?
instrument: Train a tiny prediction mechanism with a held-out comparison; inspect a gradient rather than trusting the training story.
mechanisms: Loss, derivatives, chain rule, backpropagation, gradient checking, optimisers, learning rate, train/validation split.

question: Why do two fluent systems respond differently?
instrument: Preserve controlled prompt/config comparisons; use a tiny tuning run only if it serves your question.
mechanisms: Pretraining, supervised tuning, preference optimisation, alignment, inference versus parameter updates; limits of inference about vendor internals.

question: Why did the same request slow down or stop?
instrument: Make a benchmark recipe from a real inconvenience and preserve quality as well as timing.
mechanisms: Sampling, stochasticity, output limits, batching, memory, precision, quantisation, KV cache and context costs.

question: Why did adding documents make this worse?
instrument: Compare a known fact, revised fact, absent fact and conflicting source.
mechanisms: Chunking, embeddings, similarity, retrieval, reranking, context injection, source attribution and conflict.

question: The assistant says it did something. Did it?
instrument: Follow an execution receipt through a small tool you actually want.
mechanisms: Schemas, dispatch, validation, observations, agent loops, state, permissions, retry and stop conditions.

question: The skill is attached. Where did its effect go?
instrument: Compare exact context bundles across sessions and keep a behavioural regression case.
mechanisms: Instruction placement, lazy loading, context competition, instruction/data separation, memory selection, harness enforcement and evaluation limits.

question: Can this beautiful page still account for its claims?
instrument: Compile selected exact revisions, including a failure and correction, then follow a claim back.
mechanisms: Extraction versus synthesis, provenance, compression, retrieval quality, versioned builds, human correction.
